title: Manual Resolve
description: manual-resolve/v1 — a party asking to discharge the report's obligation without any collateral moving, because it was settled between the parties outside the platform or the call no longer stands. Either party may ask; the counterparty answers, and the request is already the requester's own consent. Nothing closes until it is accepted, and a refusal ends nothing — the exceptions stay open, so the requester may ask again with new grounds or post after all. The event cites every exception it answers in its reference list; `exceptionIds` is the readable mirror of that list and must agree with it.

manualResolveId.description: Identity of this request, minted by the facade. The answer names it, and so does the completion that follows an acceptance.

reportId.description: The report whose obligation would be discharged.

exceptionIds.description: The open exceptions this request answers. A multi-leg failure is ONE conversation, not one per leg, so a request may answer several at once. Mirrors the event's own reference list.

requestedBy.description: The organization asking. Events carry roles rather than organizations, so the document pins the organization.

reason.description: Why closing without collateral is appropriate — not a restatement of why the leg failed, which the exception already carries.
